title: Biofunctionalization of PDMS-based microfluidic systems
protocol: Clean flat PDMS surfaces with ethanol 96%.
Rinse cleaned PDMS surfaces with DI H₂O.
Immerse PDMS in a 1 mg/ml PEG solution in DI H₂O for 1 hour.
Rinse PDMS with DI H₂O after PEG immersion.
Dry PDMS with N₂ after rinsing.
Immerse PDMS in a 1 mg/ml PVA solution in DI H₂O for 1 hour.
Rinse PDMS with DI H₂O after PVA immersion.
Dry PDMS with N₂ after rinsing.
Immerse PDMS in an acidic solution containing DI H₂O, 37% HCl and 30% H₂O₂ in a 5:1:1 (v/v/v) ratio for 1 hour.
Rinse PDMS with DI H₂O after chemical oxidation.
Dry PDMS with N₂ after rinsing.

Measure the contact angle with a contact angle meter: deposit a drop of water on the modified PDMS surfaces and compare the angle formed between the drop and the surface to the angle formed using a non-modified PDMS surface.
Calculate the mean value of the contact angle and its standard deviation.
Make an XPS analysis of the modified and non-modified PDMS surfaces.
